control.description-key: Interactive Mantis signalling map. Tap an asset for its drawings.

property.name: Asset
property.description-key: Asset ID to show, e.g. WVS933. The map flies to it and opens its panel.

property.name: LinkHandling
property.description-key: Browser: drawings open in a new tab. App: drawings are passed out through LinkToOpen so the app can Launch() them.

property.name: SelectedAsset
property.description-key: The asset the user has open on the map, blank when none.

property.name: SelectedKind
property.description-key: What the selected asset is, e.g. Signal, Points, Location case.

property.name: LinkToOpen
property.description-key: With Link handling = App: the drawing or link the user tapped. Use OnChange: If(!IsBlank(Self.LinkToOpen), Launch(Self.LinkToOpen)).
